game.title: Tomb Raider
game.blurb: Action-adventure reboot in which a young Lara Croft is stranded on a hostile island, from Crystal Dynamics, released 2013-03-05. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, with the story order taken from StrategyWiki's walkthrough contents.

chapters.title: The Story: Opening Sections
chapters.summary: The first seven walkthrough sections, from "Survive" to "Mountain Rendezvous". These are the ones StrategyWiki has written.

chapters.title: The Story: Middle Sections
chapters.summary: From "Cry for Help" to "Into the Fire". Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Story: Final Sections
chapters.summary: From "Get to the Chopper" to "Going Back In", and finishing the game. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Optional Tombs and Challenges
chapters.summary: The seven optional tombs and the challenges spread around the island.

chapters.title: Combat

chapters.summary: Multiplayer modes, ranked matches, levels and upgrades.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the guide under "Tomb Raider (2013)" at completion stage 2. Its Table of Contents lists 24 walkthrough sections and 7 optional tombs; only the first seven walkthrough sections ("Survive", "Force of Will", "Signs of Life", "Woman Versus Wild", "Just Keep Moving", "At an Impasse", "Mountain Rendezvous", about 1,100 to 3,000 characters each) are written, plus Achievements and trophies, Controls and Skills. The tomb pages and the later 17 walkthrough sections are not written, so coverage is partial. Its structure was recorded in sw-structure.json; section names only, no text copied. The three story chapters split the section list into thirds, which is a guess. tombraider.fandom.com redirects "Tomb Raider (2013)" to "Tomb Raider (2013 Game)", with about 192 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's first result is the 2013 game (id 5286). The Steam app list calls 203160 "Tomb Raider Game of the Year", and its schema calls it "ValveTestApp203160"; it is the only Steam app matching the 2013 game. 3 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden ("Boom Goes the Dynamite", "Crab Cakes", "Chatterbox"); they sit in the final story chapter as a placeholder, and "Chatterbox" (2.2 percent) may be optional. 15 achievements are for multiplayer.
